decisions.name: Melitius of Lycopolis
decisions.reason: Issued document in his name (the schedule of his clergy he handed to Alexander, 327), as preserved by Athanasius (year: the split began c.306 per voices line; last active 327, the schedule)

decisions.name: John Archaph
decisions.reason: No writing of his own in the Library; known only from Sozomen, Athanasius and letters written to him (Pinnes's letter, Constantine's summons).

decisions.name: Apa Paieous
decisions.reason: The Hathor letters are addressed to him; the one letter (P. Lond. 1921) whose address reads 'From Paiéous' is doubted by Bell himself (bell_jews...1924.txt 6885-6912), so the authorship is disputed. Not Aurelius Pageus of P. Lond. 1913, whom Bell keeps distinct (line 3941).

decisions.name: Arsenius
decisions.reason: His own letter of submission (c.332), issued with his presbyters and deacons (joint); NPNF dates it 'probably 332' (line 21772-21788); last active at Tyre 335

decisions.name: Callistus
decisions.reason: His own letter (P. Lond. 1914), in Bell's English (year: Bell dates it 334 or 335, 'more probably the latter', line 3463-3465)

decisions.name: Athanasius of Alexandria
decisions.reason: His own writing (year: bishop from 328, voices line; last 373). Planned person athanasius-of-alexandria has its home in alexandria-catechetical, not here, so he is a named voice on this row

decisions.name: Cyril of Alexandria
decisions.reason: Shelf row, author cyril_alexandria: his second and third letters to Nestorius (year: bishop from 412)

decisions.name: Dioscorus of Alexandria
decisions.reason: His own spoken words in the verbatim synod minutes of 449 (year: patriarch from 444; died in exile 454)

decisions.name: Timothy Aelurus
decisions.reason: Shelf row, author timothy-aelurus: his Refutation of Chalcedon (year: chosen bishop 457)

decisions.name: Severus of Antioch
